source_name: field of definition vs field of moduli
source_body_exact: Are all PCF maps defined over their field of moduli?
literal_scope: Are all PCF maps defined over their field of moduli? The source supplies no degree-parity, trivial-automorphism, odd-postcritical-cardinality, or polynomial-only condition. It does not explicitly state dimension, degree, characteristic, algebraic closure, or conjugacy convention. The workshop title is complex and arithmetic dynamics; nearby items separately mention P1 and PN. A P1 characteristic-zero result must be labeled as that scope, not silently equated with the literal universal statement.

working_definitions_before_candidate.P1_working_domain: Degree at least 2 rational self-maps of P1 over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, commonly C or Qbar when arithmetic descent is asked. PCF means each critical point has finite forward orbit. This is an explicit conventional working domain, not wording supplied by 2.6.
working_definitions_before_candidate.field_of_moduli: Fixed field of automorphisms of the coefficient field that preserve the conjugacy class under PGL2; one must state whether absolute or relative automorphisms are meant.
working_definitions_before_candidate.field_of_definition: A representative of the conjugacy class with coefficients in the stated field, on P1 over that field. Descent to an unspecified nonsplit genus-zero curve alone does not fulfill this conventional criterion.

full_target_success_criteria.yes: A proof covering every PCF map in the explicitly resolved intended domain, including nontrivial automorphisms, even/odd degrees and canonical finite-set cardinalities, polynomial/nonpolynomial and flexible Lattes cases, with field assumptions stated; or a cited established theorem whose hypotheses cover that full domain.
full_target_success_criteria.no: A concrete PCF conjugacy class with rigorously computed field of moduli K and a proved absence of any P1 model over K; PCF, stabilizer/Galois descent, and obstruction must all be independently checkable.
full_target_success_criteria.partial: A criterion for a restricted family, a proof conditional on an unsupported central lemma, or a literature gap does not answer the full universal question.

falsification_criteria: Any asserted universal affirmative conclusion is falsified by a valid PCF descent obstruction.
A restricted criterion fails if a qualifying map has no model over K, or if a claimed invariant zero-cycle does not actually descend to the relevant twist.
A negative answer fails if the example is not PCF, its claimed FOM is wrong, or a K model exists.
Priority claims fail if the operative mechanism/conclusion is already in earlier literature. A proof may remain correct while novelty fails.
boundary_cases: Nontrivial dynamical automorphism group, where conjugating isomorphisms need not be unique and may fail a cocycle.
Even/odd reduced postcritical cardinality; ramification multiplicity differs from reduced support cardinality.
Polynomial classes, critical periodicity versus eventual periodicity, and Lattes classes.
Infinite Galois groups and continuity/finite descent data; nonperfect or positive-characteristic fields require separate statements.
Source dimensional ambiguity must stay visible.
